identity.symptom: generated context registry excluded from application typechecking
identity.scenario: minimal scaffold with database and auth

what: Starter applications exclude generated database/auth context declarations from TypeScript checking.
expected: All starter TypeScript programs admit generated context declarations so authored functions receive their database and auth types.
observed: Actual app typecheck loses database/auth properties; a focused template TypeScript program cannot find namespace Relkit.
root_cause: All five templates/default/v1/*/tsconfig.json files admitted generated route checks but omitted .relkit/generated/context-registry.d.ts, while excluding .relkit from includes. The registry existed on disk but was not a TypeScript program root.
fixed_by: Include the existing generated context registry alongside route-module-checks in every starter's authored tsconfig. The app recovered through the unchanged live CLI after the same authored config correction. All five isolated TypeScript template probes, fresh real CLI scaffold/check, final app typecheck and adjacent scaffolds pass.

invariants: Generated context declarations are part of every starter TypeScript program
The live CLI recovers after valid authored config repairs

environment.target: macOS Bun 1.3.10; local commerce lab and disposable generated CLI fixtures
environment.monitoring: Real source CLI diagnostics, native migration command exits, SQLite catalog/journal queries and TypeScript diagnostics; existing local runtime HTTP logs. No remote telemetry configured in this local app.

reproduction: Generate minimal starter and add auth/SQLite.
Use context.database and context.auth in application functions and run typecheck.
Observe missing context properties despite the generated declaration file existing.
Run the focused TypeScript program root regression against original template config; it fails with missing Relkit namespace.
Include the generated declaration in authored app/templates; replay typecheck, source CLI scaffolding and all five template probes.
